The option obtains its source, calls process_value (which performs conversion and callbacks), and only afterward writes the source to the context. Prompt input is also processed through process_value before the source is attributed as PROMPT. Thus processing does not reliably observe the current value's source as claimed, even though the later slot arbitration does track a winning source.

interpretation: Descriptive diagnostics added after observing a probability/verdict inconsistency in the exploratory screen. Preserve literal probabilities; do not invert or impute. Nonzero exit codes can be informative counterexamples, and tool counts are not verification quality. No new confirmatory tests.
